in our temporary podcast
recording studio as we make the move

talking with Keven Coates,

at Novium Designs.

or five years ago at PCB West.

have attended PCB West,

very interesting topics

Keven, thanks so much
for being here today.

- Absolutely. Yeah.

have had you on earlier,

you are a new guest,

overview about your background

people who, I've been around,

at Texas Instruments.

Were you just doing the eval board design?

What were you doing over
at Texas Instruments?

when you have a job
